title: Around 60 reports on possible election campaign breaches filed in Latvia
summary_full: The Corruption Prevention and Combating Bureau (KNAB) has so far received around 60 complaints regarding possible pre-election campaign violations. These have been confirmed in at least four cases, Latvian Radio reported on September 2.
